Upgrade Your Bridge

Broken Dental Bridge?

Stop damaging healthy teeth. Replace your failing bridge with self-supporting implants designed for long-term use.

Free 15-Min Chat1-Hour Consultation — £80Call 020 71833573

✓ No Drilling Healthy Teeth · ✓ Stronger Than Bridges · ✓ 0% Finance*

For decades, dental bridges were the standard for replacing missing teeth. However, bridges have a fundamental flaw: they rely on the adjacent natural teeth for support.

Over time, the heavy load of chewing can cause these supporting teeth to fail, whether through decay leaking under the crowns, root fractures, or gum disease. When a bridge fails, it often means losing not just the bridge, but the supporting teeth as well, resulting in a larger gap than you started with.

At Dental Implants London, we help patients break this cycle. We replace failing bridges with Dental Implants, which are self-supporting and do not rely on or damage your remaining natural teeth.

Why Do Bridges Fail?

Decay Under Crowns

Bacteria can leak under the edges of the bridge supports. Since the tooth is covered, you often won't feel pain until the decay is extensive.

Overloading

Asking two teeth to do the work of three or four can eventually lead to mechanical failure or root fractures.

Bone Shrinkage

Bridges don't stimulate the jawbone under the fake tooth (pontic). The bone shrinks, creating an unsightly gap between the bridge and gum.

Difficult Hygiene

Cleaning under a bridge is difficult, making the supporting teeth prone to gum disease and infection.

The Upgrade

Implant-Supported Bridges

Instead of relying on your natural teeth, we place two or more titanium implants to support the bridge. It is a completely independent structure.

Why switch to implants?

  • • Protection: Saves your remaining natural teeth from being ground down or overloaded.
  • • Longevity: Implants do not decay in the same way natural teeth do. They are designed as a long-lasting treatment option.
  • • Bone Health: Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing the "sunken" gum look.
  • • Strength: Restore strong, natural-feeling bite function.

Replace It For The Last Time

If your bridge is loose, sensitive, or unsightly, don't wait for the supporting teeth to snap. Contact us for a lasting upgrade.
